form.label: Use Case Catalog
form.description: Inventory of every deployed rule: schedule, severity, ATT&CK mapping, and whether it has fired. A rule that has never triggered is not necessarily wrong, but it is unproven, and this is where that shows.

search.query: | rest /servicesNS/-/siem_core/saved/searches splunk_server=local | search eai:acl.app=siem_core title!="default" | rex field=title "^(?<rule_id>(UC|OPS)-\d+)" | eval schedule_type = if(match(search, "rt-") OR 'realtime_schedule'="1", "real-time", "scheduled"), enabled = if('disabled'="0", "enabled", "DISABLED"), sev_label = case('alert.severity'="5","critical", 'alert.severity'="4","high", 'alert.severity'="3","medium", 'alert.severity'="2","low", true(), "info"), actions = 'actions' | join type=left rule_id [ search index=siem_summary | stats count AS alerts, latest(_time) AS last_fired BY rule_id ] | eval alerts = coalesce(alerts, 0), last_fired = if(isnull(last_fired), "never", strftime(last_fired, "%F %T")), validated = if(alerts > 0, "validated", "not yet triggered") | lookup mitre_attack_lookup rule_id OUTPUT mitre_tactic, mitre_technique_id, soc2_control | table rule_id, title, enabled, sev_label, schedule_type, cron_schedule, alerts, last_fired, validated, mitre_tactic, mitre_technique_id, soc2_control, actions | rename rule_id AS "ID", title AS "Use case", enabled AS "State", sev_label AS "Severity", schedule_type AS "Type", cron_schedule AS "Schedule", alerts AS "Alerts", last_fired AS "Last fired", validated AS "Validation", mitre_tactic AS "ATT&CK tactic", mitre_technique_id AS "Technique", soc2_control AS "SOC 2", actions AS "Alert actions" | sort "ID"

| rest /servicesNS/-/siem_core/saved/searches splunk_server=local | search eai:acl.app=siem_core title!="default" | rex field=title "^(?<rule_id>(UC|OPS)-\d+)" | join type=left rule_id [ search index=siem_summary | stats count AS alerts BY rule_id ] | eval status = if(coalesce(alerts,0) > 0, "Triggered in window", "Awaiting activity") | stats count BY status
| inputlookup mitre_attack_lookup | stats count BY severity | sort severity

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler app=siem_core alert_actions=* | stats count AS executions, sum(result_count) AS raw_results BY savedsearch_name | eval suppression_ratio = round(raw_results / executions, 1) | sort - raw_results | head 10 | rename savedsearch_name AS "Rule", executions AS "Fires", raw_results AS "Raw results", suppression_ratio AS "Results per fire"
